rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; project retained; model value dropped from the fixture. The project figures every worksheet line: line 6 (line 4 less line 5) also when line 4 is not more than line 5, where the worksheet skips it, and the worksheet lines for a married filer filing separately, who cannot take the deduction. Line 8 uses line 6 only when line 4 is more than line 5, and the deduction (sli.deduction, which Schedule 1 line 21 copies) is zero for a married filer filing separately; on every case the model and the project agree on the deduction.

Ruling: representation; project retained; model value dropped from the fixture. A married filer filing separately cannot take the deduction (i1040gi p. 98, 'Your filing status is any status except married filing separately') and does not use the worksheet; the project figures every worksheet line for such a filer and applies the bar in sli.eligible, so sli.deduction, which Schedule 1 line 21 copies, is 0.00, as the model's line 9; the model wrote the bar into the lines instead. The project's line 1 is the interest 3,000.00 limited to 2,500.00 (p. 99, line 1). Dropped from the fixture as not evidence.
